programs.name: GitHub and npm
programs.review: Low-volume automation allowed. Limit to public login HTML and referenced first-party scripts. No repositories, user information, accounts, upstream dependencies, payloads or form actions.

programs.name: HackerOne approved test pages
programs.review: Policy reviewed in browser September 27 IST. AI research safe harbor; X-Bug-Bounty tool identifier accepted. Only specifically approved test-program pages and first-party scripts. No reports, customer programs, customer records or DoS testing.

programs.name: LiveDune
programs.review: Published scope includes *.livedune.com and automation is limited to 3 requests/second. Only public sign-in page and directly referenced scripts on the same host, no customer data or login submission. Raw scanner reports are ineligible without demonstrated impact.
